# Tutchonce Cleaning Services

> Nigeria's premier professional cleaning company offering residential, commercial, post-construction, and facility management services with eco-friendly products and 100% satisfaction guarantee.

## About
Tutchonce Cleaning Services is a Nigerian-based professional cleaning company serving homes and businesses across Nigeria. We transform living and workspaces into healthier, fresher environments using industry-standard tools and eco-safe products.

## Services
- **General Cleaning**: Standard dusting, vacuuming, mopping, sanitizing for homes and offices
- **Facility Management**: Comprehensive property maintenance and upkeep
- **Move In/Move Out Cleaning**: Specialized deep cleaning for relocations
- **Post Construction Cleaning**: Thorough after-build cleanup and debris removal
- **Renovation Cleaning**: During and after renovation cleaning services
- **Janitorial Services**: Regular scheduled commercial cleaning contracts
- **Fumigation & Pest Control**: Professional pest elimination services

## Service Areas
- Lagos, Nigeria
- Abuja, Nigeria  
- Nationwide service available
